query:
SELECT pc.id, pc.`key`, pc.labelDe, pc.labelEn FROM product_categories pc WHERE pc.`key` = 'magnetspielzeug';
SELECT pt.id, pt.categoryId, pt.name, pt.descriptionDe, pt.requiredDocuments, pt.optionalDocuments, pt.requiredDataFields FROM product_templates pt WHERE pt.name LIKE '%Magna%';
